~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ fw1-ctxm FW context ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
changeto context NOVA33
config terminal
!
!
object-group network VRF_NOVA-WLAN31_Subnets
  network-object 10.45.56.128 255.255.255.192
!
access-list NOVA-WLAN31_access_in extended permit ip 10.45.56.128 255.255.255.192 any
!
route NOVA-WLAN31 10.45.56.128 255.255.255.192 10.45.55.246 1
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub28 building router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VRF START ########### 
!
ip vrf NOVA-WLAN31
  rd 64000:3425
  route-target export 64000:3425
  route-target import 64000:3425
!
router bgp 64000
  address-family ipv4 vrf NOVA-WLAN31
    redistribute connected
    redistribute static
    no synchronization
        network 0.0.0.0
        exit-address-family
!
! ########### VRF END ############# 


! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 3737
  name BLDE01-LINK32=NOVA-WLAN31
!
interface GigabitEthernet2/28
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
interface vlan3737
  description BLDE01-LINK32=NOVA-WLAN31
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding NOVA-WLAN31
  ip address 10.45.56.189 255.255.255.192
  ip helper-address 142.100.1.1
  standby ip 10.45.56.190
  standby preempt
  standby priority 105
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 ewhr324jflewfjosdfjofds
  no shutdown
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
ip multicast-routing vrf NOVA-WLAN31
!
ip vrf NOVA-WLAN31
  mdt default 239.100.2.11
  mdt data 239.2.2.128 255.255.255.192 threshold 10
  mdt log-reuse
!
interface Vlan3737
  ip pim sparse-mode
!
!copy running start
!
! ########### MULTICAST END ############# 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site02-hub28 building router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VRF START ########### 
!
ip vrf NOVA-WLAN31
  rd 64000:3425
  route-target export 64000:3425
  route-target import 64000:3425

router bgp 64000
  address-family ipv4 vrf NOVA-WLAN31
    redistribute connected
    redistribute static

        network 0.0.0.0

 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737

interface vlan3737
  description BLDE01-LINK32=NOVA-WLAN31
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding NOVA-WLAN31
  ip address 10.45.56.188 255.255.255.192
  ip helper-address 142.100.1.1
  standby ip 10.45.56.190
  standby preempt
  standby priority 100
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 ewhr324jflewfjosdfjofds
  no shutdown
!

!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

! ########### MULTICAST START ###########

ip multicast-routing vrf NOVA-WLAN31

  mdt default 239.100.2.11

interface Vlan3737

!
!copy running start

! ########### MULTICAST END ############# 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub1 FW context router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
ip route 10.45.56.128 255.255.255.192 10.45.54.17 name NOVA33:BLDE01-LINK32=NOVA-WLAN31
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
ip multicast-routing vrf NOVA-WLAN31
!
ip vrf NOVA-WLAN31
  mdt default 239.100.2.11
  mdt data 239.2.2.128 255.255.255.192 threshold 10
  mdt log-reuse
!
interface Loopback34250000
  description RP Loopback for VRF NOVA-WLAN31
  ip vrf forwarding NOVA-WLAN31
  ip address 10.239.0.0 255.255.255.255
  ip pim sparse-mode
!
ip pim vrf NOVA-WLAN31 rp-address 10.239.0.0
!
interface Loopback34250001
  description MSDP Loopback for VRF NOVA-WLAN31
  ip vrf forwarding NOVA-WLAN31
  ip address 10.239.0.1 255.255.255.255
  ip pim sparse-mode
!
ip msdp vrf NOVA-WLAN31 peer 10.239.0.2 connect-source Loopback34250001
ip msdp vrf NOVA-WLAN31 cache-sa-state
ip msdp vrf NOVA-WLAN31 originator-id Loopback34250001
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### MULTICAST END #############

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ bldg05-sw01-04 building distribution switch ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 3737
  name BLDE01-LINK32=NOVA-WLAN31
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/1/4
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
interface GigabitEthernet2/1/4
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
interface Port-channel1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END #############
